candidate.blueprint_locator: Psychosocial Integrity, printed p.10 / PDF p.14: promote a therapeutic environment; assess the potential for violence and use safety precautions; assess client support system to aid in plan of care; incorporate behavioral management techniques
candidate.blueprint_topic: Psychosocial Integrity — suicide risk reduction / individualized safety planning
candidate.educational_objective: Collaboratively develop an individualized suicide safety plan that identifies warning signs, coping strategies, sources of support, professional resources, and environmental safety steps.

options.A: Only a list of prescribed medications and their administration times
options.B: Warning signs, personal coping strategies, supportive people or places, professional resources, and steps to make the environment safer
options.C: A generic instruction to seek help that is identical for every client
options.D: Only the client's psychiatric diagnoses and previous hospitalization dates

candidate.rationale: SAMHSA and VA safety-planning resources describe a structured, individualized plan that includes warning signs, internal coping strategies, social distractions, family or friends who can help, professionals or agencies to contact, and actions to make the environment safer. Therefore B is the best answer. Medication lists or diagnostic history alone do not constitute the safety plan, and the plan is individualized rather than a single generic instruction.
candidate.source_claim_supported: A suicide safety plan is an individualized, structured crisis tool containing warning signs, coping strategies, social/professional supports and environmental-safety steps rather than medication reminders alone.
candidate.source_document_title: Safety Plan; Build a Safety Plan
candidate.source_locator: Safety Plan resource modified from Stanley & Brown; Build a Safety Plan description: six-step plan includes warning signs, coping strategies, people/places for distraction, people to ask for help, professionals/resources to contact, and safety actions
candidate.source_organization: Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA), 988 campaign
candidate.stem: A nurse collaborates with a client at risk for suicide to develop an individualized safety plan. Which content should the plan include?
